layout_system:
SHELL (.shell): CSS grid, columns 'var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr) var(--bar)', rows 'auto auto', align-content start, gap 20px, padding 20px, min-height 100vh, box-sizing border-box; inline style font-size 15px, line-height 1.5, page background and 24px dot grid. --bar = clamp(57px, 5.13vw, 74px) (about 73.9px at 1440 wide). Column 1 = left context bar (.ctxbar, grid-column 1, row 1, align-self start, position relative). Column 2 = canvas (.dash, grid-column 2, row 1). Column 3 = empty mirror gutter of the same width (keeps the canvas centred). Row 2 = main bar (.mainbar, grid-column 1 / -1, justify-self center, max-width 100%, flex-wrap wrap, justify-content center, position sticky, bottom 20px).

CANVAS GRID (.dash): display grid, grid-template-columns repeat(12, minmax(0,1fr)), grid-auto-rows minmax(72px, auto), gap 20px, align-self start, min-width 0. Widgets (.w) are flex columns, position relative, min-width 0 / min-height 0. Every widget spans 3 rows (3 x 72 + 2 x 20 = 256px minimum height). Span classes: .c7 (span 7), .c5 (span 5), .c4 (span 4), .c3 (span 3). Default packing at 1440 (grid auto-flow row): Row A = Start a routine 7 + Credits & tier 5; Row B = Recent routines 4 + Insight 4 + Consented partners 4; Row C = My report 3 + Rewards catalog 5 + free slot 4. Approximate geometry at 1440x934: canvas x 113.9 to 1326.1, column 82.7px, column pitch 102.7px; Row A y 20-276, Row B y 296-552, Row C y 572-828; main bar y about 848-913; left bar x 20-93.9.

FREE-CELL PLACEHOLDER: a .c4 div spanning 4 x 3, flex-centred, border 1px dashed oklch(0.84 0.018 275), radius 12px, text '4 × 3 free · drop a widget here' (14px / 700 muted). Comment: 'Empty grid slot: where a new or resized widget snaps'. No drop logic is implemented on this board.

SNAPPING / DRAG / RESIZE: described only in copy (guide step 11: 'Drag a widget by its title bar to move it. Use Resize in the left bar to pick S, M, L or XL — small widgets show less, large ones show more, text never shrinks... Everything snaps to the same grid, with the same gaps.'). Pin, Resize and Hide buttons render but have no handlers here; widget title bars only select.

TOOLBAR RATIO SCALING (comment: 'toolbars scale by RATIO: one unit (1em = 13px at 1440 wide, clamped 10–13px) drives every size and gap'): .ctxbar and .mainbar font-size clamp(10px, 0.9vw, 13px), box-sizing border-box, children flex none. Left bar: width 100%, padding .77em .62em, gap .31em, radius .92em; header padding .31em .31em .62em, margin-bottom .31em; kicker .77em; title .92em; tool buttons width 100%, min-height 4em, padding .46em .15em, gap .23em, radius .92em, labels .77em; divider margin .31em 0; svg 1.7em square. Main bar: padding .62em, gap .31em, radius .92em; logo link 3.4em square, logo img height 2.6em; dividers height 2.15em, margin 0 .31em; buttons font-size 1em, radius .92em, height 3.4em, gap .62em; .main buttons 4.9em x 3.7em, gap .15em, labels .77em; Sharing badge .62em square at top .46em right 1.08em; Account button padding 0 .92em 0 .31em, avatar 2.77em square font 1em, name 1em, role .85em.

BREAKPOINT <=1180px: shell columns 'var(--bar) minmax(0,1fr)' (right mirror gutter dropped); canvas 6 columns; .c7 and .c5 become span 6; .c4 and .c3 become span 3.

BREAKPOINT <=720px (phone): shell single column; left bar moves to grid row 1 as a horizontal strip (width auto, flex-direction row, wrap, align-items center), its header takes flex 1 1 100% (own line, no bottom border/margin), tool buttons width 4.3em; canvas in row 2, one column, every widget span 1; main bar row 3, justify-self stretch, gap 4px.

GUIDE CARD LAYER: .guide is position fixed, z-index 4, width 340px, max-width calc(100vw - 40px), max-height calc(100vh - 126px), overflow auto, transition left/top .35s ease; left/top bound to state guideLeft/guideTop (px). At <=720px: width calc(100vw - 40px) !important, max-height 45vh, and the placement code ignores the left bar (minLeft = 20). Stacking: overlay z 2; spotlit target z 3; guide card z 4; main bar z 1 when not targeted; widgets and left bar z auto when not targeted.

GUIDE PLACEMENT RULES (place()): GAP 20. minLeft = left-bar right edge + 20 (or 20 when width <= 720). maxTop = max(20, min(mainBarTop, viewportHeight) - 20 - cardHeight), i.e. the card never sits lower than 20px above the main bar. clampL keeps left between minLeft and W - 20 - cardWidth; clampT keeps top between 20 and maxTop. 'overlaps' = card rectangle grown by 20px intersects the target rectangle. If not forced and the current position is in view and does not overlap the target, the card stays put. Otherwise candidates in order: right of target (left = r.right + 20, top = clampT(r.top)); left of target (left = r.left - 20 - cw, same top); below (left = clampL(r.left), top = r.bottom + 20); above (left = clampL(r.left), top = r.top - 20 - ch); above right-aligned (left = clampL(r.right - cw), top = r.top - 20 - ch); default top-right (W - 20 - cw, 20); top-left (minLeft, 20). First candidate in view and not overlapping wins; if none, the corner farthest from the target's centre (target centre x > W/2 -> top-left, else top-right). Result rounded and clamped; state updated only if it moved by more than 1px. Re-run on window resize, on any scroll (capture phase), and via requestAnimationFrame after any step or tour change; forced on mount. Initial guideLeft -9999 hides the card off-screen until the first placement.

Main bar item 14: 'Org admin' link, href 'Admin.dc.html', 64x48 column, users icon, 10px/700 muted, no underline. Renders on two lines ('Org' / 'admin') in the screenshot.
Main bar item 15: divider.

Main bar item 16: Account button, aria-label 'Account: Dana Cohen, Captain', height 44px, padding 0 12px 0 4px, gap 10px, transparent: 36px navy circle avatar with white 'DC' (13px/800), then 'Dana' (13px/800) over 'Captain' (11px muted), line-height 1.15. No handler.
Main bar hover: .main:hover background oklch(0.975 0.006 275).

LEFT CONTEXT BAR: <aside aria-label='Selected widget tools' data-guide='ctxbar' class='ctx ctxbar'>, 74px wide (100% of --bar column via ratio CSS), flex column, gap 4px, padding 10px 8px, surface bg, hairline border, radius 12px, floating shadow, z-index {{zCtx}} (3 whenever the guide step has a target other than the main bar, i.e. the ctxbar step and every widget step; otherwise auto), box-shadow {{ringCtx}} (spotlight ring in the same cases).

Left bar header: block with padding 4px 4px 8px, bottom hairline, margin-bottom 4px: kicker {{ctxKicker}} (10px/800 uppercase 0.06em navy) over title {{ctxTitle}} (12px/800, overflow-wrap anywhere — in the screenshot 'Nothing selected' wraps as 'Nothing / selecte / d').

Left bar tools ({{tools}} loop): button.tool, aria-label = label, column, centred, gap 3px, min-height 52px, padding 6px 2px, radius 12, no border, icon 22px, label 10px/700. Colours: primary tool bg #BD2025 / fg #fff; other tools transparent / muted; when the guide action row with the same label is hovered: bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275), fg #0E153E, spotlight ring (primary keeps red bg but gets the ring). run is a no-op. .tool:hover bg oklch(0.975 0.006 275).
Left bar, nothing selected: kicker 'Dashboard', title 'Nothing selected', tools 'Add' (plus), 'Arrange' (2x2 grid), 'Reset' (circular-arrow reset), 'Lock' (padlock). No selection-only block.

Left bar, widget selected: kicker 'Widget', title = widget name, 3-4 widget tools (first one red primary), then a 1px hairline divider (margin 4px 0), then 'Pin' (pin icon 20px, aria 'Pin widget', min-height 48, transparent, muted, box-shadow {{hlPin}}), 'Resize' (diagonal-arrows icon, aria 'Resize widget', {{hlResize}}), 'Hide' (eye-off icon, aria 'Hide widget', {{hlHide}}), 'Esc' (X icon 18px stroke 2, aria-label 'Deselect', min-height 44, 1px hairline border, {{hlEsc}}, onClick clear -> selected 'none'). Pin/Resize/Hide have no handlers.

Per-widget left-bar sets (CTX table): start -> kicker 'Widget', title 'Start a routine', tools Continue (play, primary), Partner (userPlus), Context (chat bubble), Last used (clock). tier -> 'Credits & tier': Redeem (gift, primary), Rules (book), Log (clock). recent -> 'Recent routines': Open last (open-external, primary), Copy cards (copy), Reflect (chat), Filter (funnel). insight -> 'Insight · Week 41': Confirm (check, primary), Past (clock), Snooze (bell). partners -> 'Consented partners': Request (userPlus, primary), Review (users), Revoke (x). report -> 'My report': Upload (upload, primary), Privacy (shield), Preview (eye). rewards -> 'Rewards catalog': Catalog (gift, primary), Redeemed (clock), Rules (book).

GUIDE DIM OVERLAY (only while tourOn): <div aria-hidden='true'> fixed, inset 0, z-index 2, rgba(14,21,62,0.5), pointer-events none — dims everything not lifted to z 3, but clicks pass through so the app stays usable.

GUIDE CARD (only while tourOn): <aside aria-label='Live guide' class='guide ctx' data-guide-card='1'>, fixed at left {{guideLeft}}px / top {{guideTop}}px, 340px wide, flex column, gap 12px, padding 18px, surface bg, 1px hairline border, radius 12px, floating shadow, z-index 4, max-height calc(100vh - 126px) with scroll, glides .35s.

Guide card row 1: kicker 'Guide · step {{stepN}} of {{stepTotal}}' (rendered uppercase 'GUIDE · STEP 1 OF 12'), and on the right a 'Skip' text button (32px high, padding 0 10px, transparent, muted, 13px/700) -> ends the tour.
Guide card row 2: step title {{stepTitle}} (18px/800/1.3).

Guide card row 3: step body {{stepBody}} (

, margin 0, 14px, navy).

Guide card row 4 (only when the step has actions): block with 1px hairline top border, padding-top 10px, gap 6px: label {{actionsLabel}} (11px/800 uppercase 0.06em muted), then one row per action: div.act, grid columns 96px | minmax(0,1fr), gap 8px, margin 0 -8px, padding 4px 8px, radius 12, 13px, line-height 1.4, cursor default; left cell = label (800, navy), right cell = description (muted). Row hover bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275); mouseenter sets the highlight on the matching control, mouseleave clears it.
Guide card row 5 (only when the step has try text): box padding 10px 12px, radius 12, bg oklch(0.93 0.03 275), 13px/1.4: bold navy 'Try it:' followed by {{stepTry}}.

Guide card footer: flex, space-between, gap 8, padding-top 12px, 1px hairline top border. Left: 12 progress dots (aria-hidden), 6x6 round, gap 5px; current dot #0E153E, completed dots oklch(0.84 0.018 275), upcoming dots oklch(0.9 0.012 275). Right (gap 6px): 'Back' (only from step 2 on; 40px, padding 0 14px, 1px strong border, transparent, navy, 14px/700) and the primary button {{nextLabel}} = 'Next' (steps 1-11) or 'Finish' (step 12) (40px, padding 0 16px, red bg, white, 14px/700).

interactions: Board start state: { guideLeft: -9999, guideTop: 20, selected: 'none', routine: 'flight', tour: true, step: 0 } — the guide is open on step 1 when the page loads (board label in the shell: 'Live guide · press Play, then Next'). The desktop board is the same code with tour: false.
Next: on steps 1-11 calls go(step+1); on step 12 ('Finish') sets tour false and selected 'none' (closes the guide, clears selection).
Skip: sets tour false and selected 'none' at any step.
Main-bar 'Guide' button (startTour): sets tour true and guideLeft -9999 (card hidden off-screen until re-placed), then go(0) — always restarts from step 1.

go(i): sets step = i and selected = the step's target if it is a widget key (start, tier, recent, insight, partners, report, rewards); for mainbar, ctxbar or no target, selected = 'none'. So each widget step auto-selects that widget, which switches the left bar to that widget's actions and draws the 2px navy selection outline.

Spotlight: the step's target element gets z-index 3 (above the z 2 dim) and the ring '0 0 0 3px surface, 0 0 0 6px #0E153E'. Widget steps also lift and ring the left bar (zCtx/ringCtx are on for any target other than the main bar), so the widget and its action bar are lit together. The ctxbar step lifts only the left bar. The main-bar step lifts the main bar (z 3, otherwise z 1). Steps with no target (1 and 12) lift nothing; the whole UI is dimmed.

Dim is click-through (pointer-events none): during the tour the user can still click widget title bars, chips, main-bar shortcuts, Esc etc. Selecting another widget changes the left bar but not the step.

Action-row hover in the guide card: mouseenter sets state.hover = row label and state.hoverKeys = row keys; mouseleave clears both. Effects: (a) any left-bar tool whose label equals the hovered row label gets soft-tint bg, navy text and the ring (steps 3-10, where row labels equal tool labels); (b) any control whose key is in hoverKeys gets the ring: main-bar StartRoutine, History, Sharing, Report, Rewards, Add, Layout, Guide, and left-bar Pin, Resize, Hide, Esc. 'Add · Layout' rings both Add and Layout. Row background turns oklch(0.93 0.03 275) on hover.

Card placement: on every step change and tour toggle (requestAnimationFrame), window resize and any scroll, the card keeps its position unless it is off-screen or within 20px of the target; otherwise it tries right of, left of, below, above, above right-aligned, top-right corner, top-left corner; never over the left bar (desktop), never lower than 20px above the main bar; fallback is the corner farthest from the target centre. Movement animates left/top over .35s ease.

Estimated card positions at 1440x934 (card height varies by step, ~400-560px): step 1 top-right (1080, 20) [confirmed by screenshot]; step 2 stays top-right (does not overlap the main bar); step 3 stays; step 4 stays (card is right of Start a routine); step 5 moves left of Credits & tier (~473, 20), covering part of Start a routine; step 6 moves right of Recent routines (~545, ~270-296), over the Insight widget; step 7 right of Insight (~975, <=296); step 8 left of Consented partners (~615, <=296); step 9 stays (clear of My report); step 10 right of Rewards (~955, clamped above main bar); step 11 right of Insight (~975, <=296); step 12 stays.

Widget selection outside the guide: click a widget's title-bar button (aria 'Select widget: ...') -> selected = that key; click a routine chip -> routine = code and selected 'start'; main-bar shortcuts select widgets (Start routine -> start, History -> recent, Sharing -> partners, Report -> report, Rewards -> rewards); left-bar 'Esc' button -> selected 'none'.

Not implemented on this board: physical Esc key handling, drag-to-move, resize, pin, hide, add, arrange, reset, lock, search, theme, account menu, left-bar tool actions (run is a no-op), 'Confirm read · +10', 'Redeem'. No keyboard navigation for the guide (no arrow keys / Enter / Escape), no focus management, card is an <aside aria-label='Live guide'> rather than a dialog; dots and overlay are aria-hidden.
Links: S3 logo, 'Continue to briefing' and each Recent routines row go to 'Main.dc.html'; 'Org admin' goes to 'Admin.dc.html'.

Responsive: <=720px the guide card is full width minus 40px with max-height 45vh and may sit anywhere from x 20 (left bar is a top strip, so it is not avoided); at all widths max-height calc(100vh - 126px) with internal scroll.
guide_steps: STEP 1 of 12 — target: none (nothing spotlit, entire UI dimmed, selection 'none'; left bar shows 'Dashboard' / 'Nothing selected'). Title: 'Welcome to your canvas'. Body: 'Everything you use sits on one dashboard. Widgets snap to a grid, so you can move them, resize them and hide the ones you never use. This guide walks you through each one — take your time, nothing here is timed.' Actions: none. Try it: 'Move your mouse over the dashboard. The dimmed area is just the guide; the app is fully usable underneath.' Buttons: Skip, Next (no Back). Dots: 1st navy, 11 light. Card position: top-right corner (verified in page3.png).

STEP 2 of 12 — target: 'mainbar' (main bar lifted to z 3 and ringed; selection 'none'). Title: 'The main bar is always with you'. Body: 'The bar at the bottom holds the functions of the whole dashboard: start a routine, open your history, sharing, your report and rewards, plus adding widgets, arranging the layout, search, theme and your account. It never changes, whatever you are looking at.' Actions label: 'Main bar'. Rows: 'Start routine' — 'Begin a flight, simulator, training, debrief or coaching routine.' (hover rings main-bar Start routine); 'History' — 'Every routine you generated, with its action cards.' (rings History); 'Sharing' — 'Partners who consented to blind synergy; a dot means a pending request.' (rings Sharing); 'Add · Layout' — 'Put a widget on the canvas, or auto-arrange and reset the grid.' (rings Add and Layout). Try it: 'Hover the main bar — each button has a label underneath.' Buttons: Skip, Back, Next.

STEP 3 of 12 — target: 'ctxbar' (left bar lifted and ringed; selection 'none', so left bar shows 'Dashboard' / 'Nothing selected' with Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock). Title: 'The left bar changes with what you select'. Body: 'Click the title bar of any widget and the left bar shows only the actions for that widget — its primary action on top, then pin, resize, hide and Esc to deselect. With nothing selected it offers the dashboard tools.' Actions label: 'With nothing selected'. Rows: 'Add' — 'Choose a widget from the library.'; 'Arrange' — 'Pack widgets onto the grid without gaps.'; 'Reset' — 'Back to the default layout.'; 'Lock' — 'Freeze the layout so nothing moves by accident.' (each row hover highlights the same-named left-bar tool). Try it: 'Click any widget title bar and watch the left bar change. Press Esc there to come back.'

STEP 4 of 12 — target: 'start' (Start a routine widget lifted + ringed + selected; left bar lifted + ringed showing 'Widget' / 'Start a routine'). Title: 'Start a routine'. Body: 'The heart of the app. Pick the routine for your next session, see whether a consenting partner is available for it, then continue to the briefing form to get your action cards.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Continue' — 'Go to the briefing form for the chosen routine.'; 'Partner' — 'Switch between solo and a consented partner.'; 'Context' — 'Add aircraft, phase and scenario before generating.'; 'Last used' — 'Repeat your previous routine setup.' (each hover highlights the same-named left-bar tool; Continue is the red primary). Try it: 'Click a different routine chip — the partner line underneath updates for that routine.'

STEP 5 of 12 — target: 'tier' (Credits & tier widget + left bar spotlit; selected 'tier'). Title: 'Credits & tier'. Body: 'CRM Credits reward consistent use: generating routines, reading the weekly insight, reflecting after a session. Credits move you through readiness tiers and can be redeemed in your organization’s catalog.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Redeem' — 'Open the catalog with your balance.'; 'Rules' — 'What earns credits, and how many.'; 'Log' — 'Every credit you earned or spent.' Try it: 'Select the widget and press Rules in the left bar.'

STEP 6 of 12 — target: 'recent' (Recent routines + left bar spotlit; selected 'recent'). Title: 'Recent routines'. Body: 'Your last sessions, newest first. Solo means a self-briefing; Blind synergy means a partner’s profile was used — without ever revealing their type to you, or yours to them.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Open last' — 'Jump to the newest session and its cards.'; 'Copy cards' — 'Copy all action cards as text for your briefing notes.'; 'Reflect' — 'Close the loop: what worked, what to change (+20 credits).'; 'Filter' — 'Only solo, only synergy, or by routine.' Try it: 'Open a session and copy its cards — you can paste them anywhere.'

STEP 7 of 12 — target: 'insight' (Insight · Week 41 + left bar spotlit; selected 'insight'). Title: 'Insight of the week'. Body: 'One short, practical CRM idea per week, chosen for crews like yours. Confirming you read it earns 10 credits and keeps your weekly streak alive.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Confirm' — 'Mark it read, +10 credits, once per week.'; 'Past' — 'Browse earlier insights.'; 'Snooze' — 'Hide it until next week.' Try it: 'Press Confirm read · +10 on the widget itself; both places do the same thing.'

STEP 8 of 12 — target: 'partners' (Consented partners + left bar spotlit; selected 'partners'). Title: 'Consented partners'. Body: 'Blind synergy only works with crew who approved a sharing request, for specific routines and for a limited time. This is the anonymity wall: you see names and validity, never anyone’s psychometric type.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Request' — 'Ask a colleague to share for a routine and a number of days.'; 'Review' — 'Approve or decline requests sent to you.'; 'Revoke' — 'Withdraw a consent you gave.' Try it: 'The orange dot means someone is waiting for your answer.'

STEP 9 of 12 — target: 'report' (My report + left bar spotlit; selected 'report'). Title: 'My report'. Body: 'Your MBTI Step I/II or Symbiotics ADAPT report is what makes every routine personal. Without a verified report, routine generation is blocked. Your type is used by the system only — never shown to partners.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Upload' — 'Add or replace your report (PDF).'; 'Privacy' — 'What is stored, who can see what.'; 'Preview' — 'Check which report is linked and when.' Try it: 'Select the widget and read Privacy once — it is short.'

STEP 10 of 12 — target: 'rewards' (Rewards catalog + left bar spotlit; selected 'rewards'). Title: 'Rewards catalog'. Body: 'What your organization offers for credits — a sim slot of your choice, a coffee with the chief pilot, whatever they add. Cards tell you the cost and how far you are from affording them.' Actions label: 'Left bar when selected'. Rows: 'Catalog' — 'The full list, not just the two shown here.'; 'Redeemed' — 'Your past redemptions and their status.'; 'Rules' — 'How credits are earned.' Try it: 'Make this widget wider and it shows three cards instead of two.'

STEP 11 of 12 — target: 'insight' again (Insight widget + left bar spotlit; selected 'insight', so Pin/Resize/Hide/Esc are visible). Title: 'Make the canvas yours'. Body: 'Drag a widget by its title bar to move it. Use Resize in the left bar to pick S, M, L or XL — small widgets show less, large ones show more, text never shrinks. Hide what you do not need; Add brings it back. Everything snaps to the same grid, with the same gaps.' Actions label: 'On every selected widget'. Rows: 'Pin' — 'Keep it in place when you auto-arrange.' (rings left-bar Pin); 'Resize' — 'Change its span on the grid.' (rings Resize); 'Hide' — 'Remove it from the canvas (not from the app).' (rings Hide); 'Esc' — 'Deselect.' (rings Esc). Try it: 'Drop a widget into the dashed free slot.'

STEP 12 of 12 — target: none (nothing lifted; selection 'none'; main bar stays at z 1 under the dim). Title: 'That’s the whole system'. Body: 'Start a routine, get action cards, reflect, earn credits, and keep your sharing under your control. You can reopen this guide any time from the main bar.' Actions label: 'Main bar'. Row: 'Guide' — 'Reopens this walkthrough.' (rings main-bar Guide button). Try it: 'Press Finish, then start your first routine.' Buttons: Skip, Back, 'Finish' (closes the guide and clears selection). Dots: first 11 completed grey oklch(0.84 0.018 275), 12th navy.

open_questions: Try text in step 8 says 'The orange dot means someone is waiting for your answer.' but the dot is red #BD2025 everywhere. Change the copy to 'red dot', or change the colour?

Step 4 try text promises 'the partner line underneath updates for that routine', but in the prototype only the routine name changes; 'Yoav F. · approved, valid 14 days' is static. Should the line show the consented partner for the chosen routine (or 'Solo' when none)?
Step 12 highlights the main-bar 'Guide' button on hover, but on that step the main bar is not lifted (z 1, under the dim). Should the main bar be spotlit on the last step?
Step 11 ('Make the canvas yours') reuses the Insight widget as its demo target. Is that deliberate, or should it target a neutral or user-chosen widget, or the free slot?

Step 9 says 'MBTI Step I/II or Symbiotics ADAPT', while the widget shows 'MBTI Step II'. Which report types are supported, and what does the widget show in the missing or unverified state ('routine generation is blocked')?

The board starts with the tour open (tour: true); the desktop board starts closed. In the product: auto-open on first login only, with a per-user 'guide seen / finished / skipped' flag stored server-side? Should Skip be treated differently from Finish?

Credit rules stated in the guide copy (Confirm read +10 once per week, Reflect +20, weekly streak, tiers Ready → Proficient at 500, the catalog as redemption target) must match the backend rules. Are these the final values?

Most controls the guide teaches have no behaviour in the prototype: Pin, Resize (S/M/L/XL), Hide, Add (widget library), Arrange, Reset, Lock, Search, Theme, Account, every left-bar tool, Confirm read, Redeem, drag-and-drop into the free slot. What should each one do and open, and which full pages back them (History, Sharing, Report, Rewards, Rules, Log, Past insights, Privacy)?

Keyboard and accessibility are not specified. Should the physical Esc key deselect or close the guide? Should arrow keys or Enter step the guide? Should the card be role='dialog' or a non-modal region with aria-live step announcements, given the app stays usable underneath? Where should focus go when a step changes?

Phone behaviour of the guide (card full width, max 45vh, placement ignores the top-strip left bar) is not shown in any screenshot. Should the phone card dock to the bottom above the main bar instead of floating?
Dark theme: the guide board defines no dark tokens and the Theme button does nothing. Are dark values (overlay, ring, card) expected?
The board's 'accent' prop (#0E153E, #BD2025, #5B6080) is declared but unused. Is a per-org accent colour intended (for example white-label colours per organisation)?
The left-bar title 'Nothing selected' breaks mid-word ('selecte d') at 74px. Allow a smaller label, hyphenation, or wrapping only between words?
Main-bar 'Org admin' link appears on the crew bar. Is it shown only to users with an org-admin role?

The step order and count are fixed (12 steps, one per default widget). If a user has hidden or rearranged widgets, should steps for hidden widgets be skipped, or should the widget be revealed temporarily?
